mapper.sql: b.lambda_id, b.name, b.dev_team_id, b.code_upload_id, b.max_version, b.max_sequence
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambdas (name, description, metadata, dev_team_id, created_at) VALUES (#{lambdaName}, #{description}, #{metadata, typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.ObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{devTeamId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT lambda_id, name, description, metadata, dev_team_id, code_upload_id, created_at, max_version, max_sequence FROM lambdas WHERE lambda_id = #{lambdaId}
SELECT FROM lambdas b WHERE b.lambda_id = #{lambdaId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT h.lambda_id AS "lambda_version_lambda_id", h.lambda_version_id, h.lambda_version, h.sequence_number, h.created_by, h.created_at, h.whatsnew, h.arch, h.code_upload_id, h.status, h.status_date, h.lambda_trigger, h.schedule, v.latest_status, v.is_public, v.timeout, v.memory, v.function_start_date, v.function_name, v.async_function_name FROM lambda_versions h LEFT OUTER JOIN lambda_active_versions v ON v.lambda_id = h.lambda_id AND v.lambda_version_id = h.lambda_version_id WHERE h.lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND h.lambda_version = #{version}
AND h.status IN (#{status} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_versions (lambda_id, created_at, created_by, lambda_trigger, lambda_version, sequence_number, status, status_date, code_upload_id, arch, schedule, whatsnew) VALUES (#{lambdaId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{trigger}, #{version}, #{sequenceNumber}, #{status}, #{statusDate}, #{codeUploadId}, #{arch}, #{schedule, typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.StringMapTypeHandler}, #{whatsnew}) ON CONFLICT (lambda_id, sequence_number) DO UPDATE SET lambda_trigger = #{trigger}, lambda_version = #{version}, status = #{status}, status_date = #{statusDate}, code_upload_id = #{codeUploadId}, arch = #{arch}, schedule = #{schedule, typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.StringMapTypeHandler}, whatsnew = #{whatsnew}

INSERT INTO lambda_active_versions ( lambda_id, is_public, latest_status, lambda_version_id, lambda_version, lambda_trigger, timeout, memory, function_name, async_function_name, function_start_date, schedule_start_date, schedule) VALUES ( #{lambdaId}, #{published}, #{latest}, #{lambdaVersionId}, #{version}, #{trigger}, #{timeout}, #{memory}, #{functionName}, #{asyncFunctionName}, #{functionStartDate}, #{scheduleStartDate}, #{schedule, typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.StringMapTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (lambda_id, is_public) DO UPDATE SET latest_status = EXCLUDED.latest_status, lambda_version_id = EXCLUDED.lambda_version_id, lambda_version = EXCLUDED.lambda_version, lambda_trigger = EXCLUDED.lambda_trigger, timeout = EXCLUDED.timeout, memory = EXCLUDED.memory, function_name = EXCLUDED.function_name, async_function_name = EXCLUDED.async_function_name, function_start_date = EXCLUDED.function_start_date, schedule = EXCLUDED.schedule, schedule_start_date = EXCLUDED.schedule_start_date
mapper.update: UPDATE lambda_active_versions SET latest_status = 2, lambda_version_id = NULL, lambda_version = NULL, lambda_trigger = 0, memory = 0, timeout = 0, function_name = NULL, async_function_name = NULL, function_start_date = NULL, schedule = NULL, schedule_start_date = NULL WHERE lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND NOT is_public
mapper.select: SELECT lambda_assignment_id FROM lambda_assignments WHERE lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lambda_pending_inputs_p WHERE (tableoid, ctid) IN ( SELECT tableoid, ctid FROM lambda_pending_inputs_p WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} LIMIT #{limit})
